evidence: diff --name-status and --numstat over 2ad8e42..4f146dc confirm 17 changed paths: 10 Go/CI/doc modifications plus 7 net-new openspec files (design/entry/proposal/requirements/specs/tasks) for skills-validate-ondisk-gate.

Full patch review of .github/workflows/ci.yml shows the only change is appending the static string literal ' --source-root ../skills' to an existing 'go run ./cmd/ skills validate' invocation; no variable interpolation, secrets, or externally-controlled data enters this run: line, so the native shell_source trigger is a false positive on plain flag text, not shell injection.
Full patch review of bin/labdrian-overlay shows only a help-text/usage-string update; no executable logic changed.
Full patch of engine/cmd/main.go: doc-comment and usage-string updates only, no behavior change.

Full source read of engine/skills/ondisk.go: ScanSkillFiles(skillsDir) takes a CLI-operator-supplied local path, os.Stat's it, then filepath.WalkDir's it; entries are compared only as strings via map lookups and fmt.Sprintf %q for error text (never passed to exec/shell, SQL, or any interpreter), so untrusted input handling and injection do not apply. Dot-prefixed entries are skipped via SkipDir; no symlink-following beyond default Go WalkDir/Lstat semantics that flags reparse points as non-dir so a symlinked directory is not recursed as one.

Full patch of engine/skills/skills.go: RenderValidateCore gained a required --source-root flag (fails loud with exit 1 and a stderr message naming the flag when absent, per test TestRenderValidateCoreOnDiskGate/absent_source_root_fails_loud_naming_the_flag) and wires DeployableManifestPaths + injected scanSkills into a second, additive on-disk divergence check; no new external inputs, no auth/authorization surface, no secrets, no dependency changes (no go.mod/go.sum in the manifest).

engine/skills/ondisk_test.go and skills_test.go additions are net-new/expanded unit tests exercising the same functions with temp-dir fixtures and a stubbed scanSkills; no production behavior change beyond what ondisk.go/skills.go show.
README.md, openspec proposal/spec/design/tasks/entry.json changes are documentation only; scanned for embedded secrets/tokens/credentials — none present.

This is a local CI/dev-tooling manifest-consistency gate with no network exposure, no authentication/authorization boundary, no persisted or transmitted user data, and no dependency manifest changes; scope items (auth, data exposure/loss, unsafe input handling, secrets, dependency vulnerabilities) all inspected with no reachable impact found.

findings.claim: RenderValidateCore computes regDivs/regErr from the registry/manifest cross-check at line 110, then runs three new fatal-error early-returns (readFile(manifestPath) at 112-116, DeployableManifestPaths at 118-122, scanSkills(sourceRoot) at 124-128) before ever reaching the print loop at 134-141; any one of those three failing silently discards the already-computed regDivs and reports only the later error, contradicting the function's own stated guarantee two lines above the print loop: 'Full-scan reporting (R-007): print every divergence from both checks in this one run, never stopping at the first error.'
proof_refs: engine/skills/skills.go changed hunk: regDivs/regErr computed at line 110 (git diff 2ad8e42..4f146dc -- engine/skills/skills.go, hunk starting '// Validate loads the manifest via os.Open(manifestPath) and runs Diff.')
engine/skills/skills.go lines 112-129: three new early-return error paths (readFile, DeployableManifestPaths, scanSkills) added by this diff, none of which print regDivs before exit(1)

engine/skills/skills.go lines 132-141: the print block (guarded by 'if regErr != nil { for _, d := range regDivs ... }') is only reached if all three new stages succeed, so a scanSkills failure (e.g. a bad/inaccessible --source-root) combined with a real registry/manifest divergence reports only the scan error and drops the divergence diagnostics an operator needs
